summary.name: SRE resource library (Google)
summary.one_liner: Google's SRE resource library, a curated collection of site reliability engineering learning paths, books, videos and talks, anchored by the SRE book text.
use_cases: Finding a structured SRE learning path
Learning how Google runs large scalable systems
Discovering SRE books and reading material
Preparing for SRE roles or upskilling
summary.what_it_does: The page is Google Developers' SRE resource library, described as offering curated learning paths, site reliability books, videos and resources for all experience levels. The visible text promotes the completely rewritten edition of the Site Reliability Engineering book, edited by Betsy Beyer, Chris Jones, Christof Leng, David Huska, Jennifer Petoff and Niall Richard Murphy. The book covers Google's current SRE practices and how they have changed over the decade since the first edition. The new edition covers the value of reliability, cloud reliability, and the impact of AI. The listing notes it is linked from the awesome-sre list under conferences and meetups as SRE Tech Talks.
notable: Curated SRE learning paths for all experience levels
Rewritten edition of the Google Site Reliability Engineering book with AI and cloud reliability coverage
Collection of SRE talks and videos hosted by Google
caveats: Page text is mostly promotional; the specific resources, costs and access terms are not listed in the visible text
Book content and talks are described but their full contents are not shown on this page
